_doc: General government gross debt = GGXWDG_NGDP / 100 x NGDPD, current US dollars, IMF World Economic Outlook. The clock interpolates from the end-2025 stock on 2026-01-01 00:00 UTC to the end-2026 stock on 2027-01-01 00:00 UTC. Not a live ledger. The dollar change includes exchange-rate effects. US figures here are the IMF estimate, not Treasury Debt to the Penny.
